statement: Lemma 1 (lem:design): eqs. qd-step, Gram-exact, Gram-qd and Gram-bounds, with proof steps (a)-(e) of supplement S2
arithmetic: exact rational (fractions.Fraction); spectral-norm bounds decided by positive definiteness of x I -/+ D

designs.list_format: one line per design: T;tau_1 ... tau_m;cbar

checks.expansion: G_T - I - B/T in [-cbar^2/T^2, 0] entrywise and |B_jk| <= |cbar| + cbar^2, lambda_j T - tau_j in {0, 1/2, 999/1000} (eq. Gram-qd)
checks.a_diagonal: D_jj in [0, cbar^2/T), D_00 > 0 (proof step a)
checks.b_offdiag: D_jk in [|cbar|/T, (|cbar| + cbar^2)/T), j != k (proof step b)
checks.d_upper: ||D||_F <= (m + 1) max|D_jk| <= (m + 1)(|cbar| + cbar^2)/T and ||D|| <= (m + 1)(|cbar| + cbar^2)/T (proof step d)
checks.e_lower: v'Dv >= m|cbar|/T, e_0'De_0 = cbar^2 (T - 1)/T^2 and ||D|| >= max{m|cbar|, cbar^2 (1 - 1/T)}/T (proof step e)
